summary: IAdsService backed by AppLovin MAX, plus its IBannerAds banner. Replaces FakeAdsService and FakeBannerAds.
manualSteps: AppLovin ▸ Integration Manager → paste the SDK Key
Integration Manager → enable MAX's consent flow (Terms and Privacy Policy) and fill the privacy-policy URL
Tick the ad networks you want — each adds a com.applovin.mediation.adapters.* pair
Drag MaxAdsInstaller.asset into the game-installer slot on RootLifetimeScope (Master Scene)

Fill the ad units in the bundled config defaults (Resources/Config): ads.max.<placement>.unitId per placement (or ads.max.android.<placement>.unitId / ads.max.ios.<placement>.unitId per platform), or one format default ads.max.rewarded.unitId / ads.max.interstitial.unitId (platform form ads.max.android.rewarded.unitId …); set ads.<placement>.rewarded = 1 on each rewarded placement (absent ⇒ interstitial). Optional keys (display timeout, auto-log, dev logging / test devices): README

Banners: mark each banner placement with ads.<placement>.banner = 1 and give it a unit id — the per-placement keys above, or one banner default ads.max.banner.unitId / ads.max.android.banner.unitId / ads.max.ios.banner.unitId. A banner never falls back to an interstitial or rewarded unit
